Deliverable 3 asks for "one line per shot saying what it shows" and the pass counts. `session.jsonl` has one combined line for all three shots, and the sheet probe says "chip+v2 on/off ok" with no count. Log one line per png, plus the probe's real output.

In `proof/v2-1920.png` and `v2-3440.png`, the bottom of the desktop AI panel shows clipped old rows ("started: Dictate… / ended: Dictate… 10-17 00:09") under the Chat v2 box. These look like AIFeed or bubble rows that the v2 box does not fully replace or overlap. The ✦ sheet (`v2-400.png`) is clean. Check that `.drawer-rail-sheet-v2` fills the desktop card the way it fills the sheet.

`proof/proof.mjs:12-13`: the `open` locator is never used, and the "toggle candidates" log is leftover debugging. The desktop shots only show the drawer because it docks by default at 1920 and wider. Delete both lines, or click the toggle, so the script says what it does.

`proof/proof.mjs:2` imports Browser.mjs by an absolute `file:///C:/Code/lew42/monorepo/…` path, so it only runs on this machine and at this checkout. A path relative to `import.meta.url` would be sturdier.

On the desktop, the v2 chip in `v2-1920.png` (top right, beside "+ New session") is visibly shorter and darker than the button next to it. The pressed style comes from `ChatView.css`, but the sizing comes from `drawer-ai-switch-btn`. Making the two buttons the same height would read better.

The desktop chip keeps the `drawer-rail-sheet-v2*` class names. The brief asked for this so the sheet would not break, so it is correct, but the name now says "sheet" on a surface that is not a sheet. If it is ever renamed, the new name belongs in ChatView's own prefix.
